description: Find recurring charges such as subscriptions and bills by grouping charges per merchant and detecting a steady weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly interval. Returns each merchant's typical amount, frequency, last charge date, and total. Default window is the last 6 months; yearly charges need a window of 13 months or more. The response includes a `warnings` array of notices about banks that could not contribute (for example, a bank that needs reconnecting), each with a message and, when relevant, a reconnect_url.

account_id.description: Limit results to a specific account. Use an account id returned by list_accounts.

end_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

min_occurrences.description: Minimum number of charges from a merchant to count as recurring. Defaults to 2.

start_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 6 months ago.

name: get_recurring_charges
title: Find Recurring Charges
